I can do this, but I need explicit confirmation and a few details first — sending an attorney‑client privileged memo to an external consultant can waive privilege, so I must confirm you have authority and permission to share this specific document.

Please confirm the following before I send:

1. You authorize sending the privileged Marchetti litigation‑hold memo to raj.mehta@bridgeline-advisors.example and accept any privilege risks.
2. Confirm you have explicit approval from Legal (e.g., Karen) to share this exact memo, or that you personally are authorized to release it.
3. Attach the file here (or confirm it’s in my mailbox and specify the filename).
4. Sender name and email to send from.
5. Subject line and cover message to include (or reply “use suggested” and I’ll use:  
   Subject: “Marchetti — Litigation‑hold memo (from outside counsel)”  
   Body: “Raj — Attached is the litigation‑hold memo for the Marchetti matter. Let me know if you need anything else. — [Sender Name]”)
6. Any CC or BCC recipients.
7. Confirm you want it sent now.

Reply with confirmations and the attachment (or say “Yes, send” plus the answers to 3–6). I will not send until you explicitly confirm.
